items.source: IllegalStateException - if the underlying scope is not currently active
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果底层作用域当前未处于活动状态

items.source: ApplicationContext implementations such as a WebApplicationContext may register additional standard scopes specific to their environment, for example, "request" and "session", based on this Scope SPI.
items.translation: `ApplicationContext` 实现，例如 `WebApplicationContext`，可能会根据其环境注册额外的标准作用域，例如基于此 Scope SPI 的 `"request"` 和 `"session"`。

items.source: Scope implementations are expected to be thread-safe. One Scope instance can be used with multiple bean factories at the same time, if desired (unless it explicitly wants to be aware of the containing BeanFactory), with any number of threads accessing the Scope concurrently from any number of factories.
items.translation: Scope 实现预期是线程安全的。如果希望如此（除非它明确需要感知包含它的 BeanFactory），一个 Scope 实例可以同时与多个 BeanFactory 一起使用，并且可以由任意数量的线程从任意数量的工厂并发访问该 Scope。

items.source: Even if its primary use is for extended scopes in a web environment, this SPI is completely generic: It provides the ability to get and put objects from any underlying storage mechanism, such as an HTTP session or a custom conversation mechanism. The name passed into this class's get and remove methods will identify the target object in the current scope.
items.translation: 即使其主要用途是在 Web 环境中扩展作用域，此 SPI 也是完全通用的：它提供了从任何底层存储机制（例如 HTTP 会话或自定义对话机制）获取和放置对象的能力。传入此类的get和remove方法的名称将标识当前作用域中的目标对象。

items.source: Note that 'destruction' refers to automatic destruction of the object as part of the scope's own lifecycle, not to the individual scoped object having been explicitly removed by the application. If a scoped object gets removed via this facade's remove(String) method, any registered destruction callback should be removed as well, assuming that the removed object will be reused or manually destroyed.
items.translation: 注意，'destruction' 指的是对象作为作用域自身生命周期的一部分被自动销毁，而不是指应用程序显式移除了该作用域对象。如果通过此外观的 remove(String) 方法移除了一个作用域对象，则应同时移除任何已注册的销毁回调，前提是假设被移除的对象将被重用或手动销毁。

items.source: Since 7.0, this interface method returns null by default.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本以来，此接口方法默认返回 `null`。

items.source: objectFactory - the ObjectFactory to use to create the scoped object if it is not present in the underlying storage mechanism
items.translation: objectFactory - 用于在底层存储机制中不存在该作用域对象时创建该对象的ObjectFactory。

items.source: Note: This is an optional operation. Implementations may throw UnsupportedOperationException if they do not support explicitly removing an object.
items.translation: 注意：这是一个可选操作。 如果实现不支持显式删除对象，则可能会抛出UnsupportedOperationException。

items.source: Returns null if no object was found; otherwise returns the removed Object.
items.translation: 如果未找到对象，则返回null；否则返回被移除的Object。

items.source: Note that an implementation should also remove a registered destruction callback for the specified object, if any. It does, however, not need to execute a registered destruction callback in this case, since the object will be destroyed by the caller (if appropriate).
items.translation: 注意，实现还应移除为指定对象注册的销毁回调（如果有）。然而，在这种情况下，它确实不需要执行已注册的销毁回调，因为对象将由调用者销毁（如果适用）。

items.source: Note: This is an optional operation. This method will only be called for scoped beans with actual destruction configuration (DisposableBean, destroy-method, DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor). Implementations should do their best to execute a given callback at the appropriate time. If such a callback is not supported by the underlying runtime environment at all, the callback must be ignored and a corresponding warning should be logged.
items.translation: 注意：这是一个可选操作。 此方法仅针对具有实际销毁配置（DisposableBean、destroy-method、DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor）的作用域 Bean 调用。实现应尽力在适当的时间执行给定的回调。如果底层运行环境完全不支持此类回调，则 必须忽略该回调并记录相应的警告。

items.source: Note: This is an optional operation. It is perfectly valid to return null in an implementation of this method if the underlying storage mechanism has no obvious candidate for such an ID.
items.translation: 注意：这是一个可选操作。 如果底层存储机制没有此类 ID 的明显候选项，则在该方法的实现中返回 null 是完全有效的。

items.source: The exact meaning of the conversation ID depends on the underlying storage mechanism. In the case of session-scoped objects, the conversation ID would typically be equal to (or derived from) the session ID; in the case of a custom conversation that sits within the overall session, the specific ID for the current conversation would be appropriate.
items.translation: 会话 ID 的确切含义取决于底层存储机制。对于会话范围的对象，会话 ID 通常等于（或由）session ID 派生；对于位于整体会话内的自定义会话，当前会话的具体 ID 则更为合适。

items.source:
This is the central operation of a Scope, and the only operation
that is absolutely required.
items.translation: 这是 Scope 的核心操作，也是唯一绝对必需的操作。

items.source: Return the object with the given name from the underlying scope, creating it if not found in the underlying storage mechanism.
items.translation: 返回底层作用域中给定名称的对象， 如果未在底层存储机制中找到则创建它。

items.source: Return the conversation ID for the current underlying scope, if any.
items.translation: 返回当前底层作用域的会话 ID（如果有）。

items.source: Remove the object with the given name from the underlying scope.
items.translation: 从底层作用域中移除具有给定name的对象。

items.source:
Register a callback to be executed on destruction of the specified
object in the scope (or at destruction of the entire scope, if the
scope does not destroy individual objects but rather only terminates
in its entirety).
items.translation: 在作用域中注册一个回调，以便在指定对象销毁时执行（或者如果该作用域不单独销毁对象而只是整体终止，则在整个作用域销毁时执行）。

items.source: Resolve the contextual object for the given key, if any.
items.translation: 解析给定键的上下文对象（如有）。

items.source: name - the name of the object to retrieve
items.translation: name - 要检索的对象的名称

items.source: the desired object (never null)
items.translation: 所需对象（永远不为null）

items.source: name - the name of the object to remove
items.translation: name - 要删除的对象的名称

items.source: the removed object, or null if no object was present
items.translation: 被移除的对象，或者如果不存在对象则为null

items.source: name - the name of the object to execute the destruction callback for
items.translation: name - 要执行销毁回调的对象名称

items.source: callback - the destruction callback to be executed. Note that the passed-in Runnable will never throw an exception, so it can safely be executed without an enclosing try-catch block. Furthermore, the Runnable will usually be serializable, provided that its target object is serializable as well.
items.translation: callback - 要执行的销毁回调。请注意，传入的 Runnable 永远不会抛出异常，因此可以安全地在没有外围 try-catch 块的情况下执行。此外，只要其目标对象也是可序列化的，该 Runnable 通常也是可序列化的。

items.source: key - the contextual key
items.translation: key - 上下文键

items.source: the corresponding object, or null if none found
items.translation: 对应的对象，如果未找到则为null

items.source: the conversation ID, or null if there is no conversation ID for the current scope
items.translation: 会话 ID，或者如果当前作用域没有会话 ID 则为 `null`。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop
